title: Launch noise-to-signal mapper & readiness road-scan
content:
Purpose:
This working doc reframes launch readiness as a noise-to-signal exercise: identify which metrics and checkpoints truly predict customer impact vs which are operational noise that slows decision-making. The goal is a compact readiness scorecard and a lightweight road-scan tracker that product ops, eng, and SRE can run weekly in the 4 weeks before a staged launch.

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Produce a single 9-point readiness score (three pillars: product, platform, org) each week.
- For each pillar, track 3 high-signal KPIs + 2 watchlist metrics.
- Define 3 concrete launch triggers and 3 contingency actions mapped to threshold crossings.
- Keep checklist granular for first 72 hours after go-live (rollback, limited rollout, throttles).

How to use this doc (playbook):
1) At -28d: owner kickoff and map signal KPIs.
2) Weekly: fill road-scan table, compute pillar scores, surface blockers in PL triage.
3) At -7d: final go/no-go readout using the 9-point readiness band.
4) At +72h: post-mortem signals and quick adjustments, move remaining items into a 30d ops backlog.

Definitions: noise vs signal - Signal: correlates with end-user experience or unit economics (e.g., end-to-end p95 latency for the core API, model quality regression rate on golden prompts, conversion per experiment cohort). - Noise: internal counters with weak customer correlation (e.g., random per-shard memory churn unless it affects latency or errors).

Readiness scoring rubric (per pillar, 0-3):
- 3 = Nominal: KPIs inside green threshold, no untriaged blockers, tested runbook.
- 2 = Caution: 1 KPI in amber, mitigation planned, can launch with staged ramp.
- 1 = Risky: 1+ KPIs in red or >1 amber, mitigation requires >24h dev work.
- 0 = Stop: critical KPI failure or unresolved data/privacy/legal hold.
Combined readiness = sum(product + platform + org) -> 0..9. Recommended bands: 8-9 GO, 6-7 GO with staged rollout + strict monitoring, <=5 HOLD.

Road-scan tracker (weekly) — instructions: keep a single line per milestone; concise owner notes; use short numeric readiness per pillar.
Example rows (copy template):
- milestone: "API rate-limit sanitization for shared customers"; owner: "Evan Brooks"; eta: "2025-12-08"; deps: "infra/kv-cache-config (ENG-314)"; blockers: "rate-limiter false positives in staging"; product_score: "2"; platform_score: "1"; org_score: "3"; next_action: "hotfix + canary 10% by 12/02"
- milestone: "Model-v2 rollout gating eval"; owner: "Marta Li"; eta: "2025-12-15"; deps: "eval harness + golden-prompts"; blockers: "unexpected topical drift on legal prompts"; product_score: "1"; platform_score: "3"; org_score: "3"; next_action: "freeze rollout; quality patch due 12/10"
- milestone: "Console telemetry retention parity"; owner: "Diego Martinez"; eta: "2025-12-01"; deps: "observability team"; blockers: "SLAs for billing events not captured"; product_score: "3"; platform_score: "2"; org_score: "2"; next_action: "short-term export to S3; full pipeline by 12/05"

High-signal KPI matrix (pick up to 3 per pillar):
- Product signals: golden-prompt accuracy regression (% failing tests), feature conversion (trial->paid % for cohort A), user-reported severity (CS severity 1 per 10k sessions). - Platform signals: 95th pct API latency, error rate (5xx per 100k requests), autoscale ballast efficiency (time to reclaim underload). - Org signals: on-call runbook accept time (median ack < 5m), customer success playbook ready (doc + 2 execs trained), legal/data compliance checklist complete (all signed).
Watchlist metrics (less weight): infra mem headroom, queue size variance, daily active test accounts, non-deterministic model output rate.

Triggers & mapped contingency actions (examples):
- Trigger A (Quality): golden-prompt regression > 2% absolute across holdout -> Contingency: immediate rollout freeze; rollback to model-v1; open hotfix ticket; communicate to customers within 2 hours.
- Trigger B (Reliability): sustained p95 latency > 2.5x baseline for >10 minutes -> Contingency: shift traffic to dedicated capacity pool, reduce token limit per request, enable degraded mode (no-cost-saving features).
- Trigger C (Safety/Compliance): flagged dataset audit issue or unanswered legal sign-off -> Contingency: pause launch, engage legal within 1 hour, enable internal-only mode.

First 72h checklist (operational):
- Monitoring: dashboard with the 6 signal KPIs + alert thresholds (owner: Diego)
- Comms: ready Slack channel + customer status page template (owner: Samir)
- Ops: rollback script tested in staging and dry-run in prod sandbox (owner: Evan)
- Support: CS playbook live with canned responses + escalation ladder (owner: Marta)
- Billing: usage gating and quota caps configured for trial cohorts (owner: Product Ops)

Decision readout template (weekly):
- Week: YYYY-MM-DD
- Combined readiness score: X/9
- Top 3 blockers and estimated time-to-fix
- Required executive decision: GO / STAGED GO / HOLD
- Commitments if GO: canary %, monitoring cadence, customer comm timing

RACI (short):
- Product ops: Priya (R) overall readiness and decision facilitation
- Product: Marta (A) features & conversion metrics
- Eng/Infra: Evan (A) platform KPIs, scaling and rollback
- Observability/SRE: Diego (C) dashboards and alerts
- CS & GTM: Samir (C) comms and onboarding cadence
- Legal/Compliance: TBD (C) sign-offs

Open questions & bets (capture here weekly):
- Q: What absolute golden-prompt regression threshold is acceptable for niche enterprise customers? (sensitivity differs)
- Q: Is a 10% canary sufficient to surface region-specific infra issues? Could need 25% for region X.
- Bet: Throttling low-value tokens reduces ops cost without measurable UX impact; test in canary.

Next steps (immediate actions):
- Priya: schedule -21d cross-functional go/no-go readout (calendar invite + pre-reads).
- Marta: finalize golden prompt set and add 50 regression samples by 2025-11-10.
- Evan: triage rate-limiter false positives; propose short-term config by 2025-11-07.
- Diego: prototype combined dashboard with signal KPI tiles by 2025-11-09.

Notes to self / messy bits (raw):
- Keep weekly entries terse; this doc will be copied into the postmortem with final scores.
- Avoid adding every internal metric; if it doesn't map to customer impact, put it in the watchlist.
- If legal asks for extra paperwork, escalate to executive review lane (fast-track template exists: confluence:PRODOPS-4051).

Version history:
- 2025-11-03 created by Priya Nair (initial template + 3 example milestones).
- 2025-12-02 updated: added Trigger B and canary guidance (Marta).
- 2026-02-15 updated: refined readiness bands and first-72h checklist (Priya).

End of doc.
